description: This file defines a PHP class 'TableOfContentsRenderer' that implements the 'NodeRendererInterface' to render a table of contents macro for Confluence, returning an HTML element with specific attributes.

classes.name: TableOfContentsRenderer
classes.description: A class implementing NodeRendererInterface to render a table of contents macro in Confluence format.
